system.description:
A missile with this talent can be shot at ranges five times greater than normal. If the missile weapon firing this missile is also magical and has an additional range multiplier, the effect is cumulative; multiply each maximum range by five. If the missile weapon is not magical, use the following maximum ranges.

TypeRanges
Arrow, short bow250/500/750
Arrow, long bow350/700/1,050
Quarrel, light crossbow300/600/900
Quarrel, heavy crossbow400/800/1,200
Sling stone200/400/800

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Fletched arrows in a quiver. Can be used with a long bow or short bow. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
